hook_note: a hook call is '<side>.<hook>'; state adds '(ball,phase)', ball, ball_sprite and hides_hp add '(ball)'. sprite, title_closeup, title_pattern and focus_points are not hooks of this list. hooks_build leaves out rope (the kit asks it twice for an event that shakes the ropes)

tag_notes.FLUTE:basket: at least one basket is on the canvas
tag_notes.FLUTE:cobra: at least one cobra is up
tag_notes.FLUTE:dance: SNAKE DANCE is running (the cobras leave their baskets)
tag_notes.FLUTE:shards: its silver shards are flying (it lost)
tag_notes.FLUTE:solo_baskets: one of its two victory baskets is on screen (it won)
tag_notes.FLUTE:strike: a cobra is lunging or recoiling
tag_notes.FLUTE:swatted: a cobra was slapped flat by the lance and is still down or curling back up
tag_notes.FLUTE:wave: PICCOLO's ring is crossing the canvas
tag_notes.card: the VS title card is drawn
tag_notes.card_closed: the card is shut (no HUD under it)
tag_notes.doors: the card is sliding open or shut
tag_notes.fight: the fight, up to the K.O.
tag_notes.fringe: chromatic fringing on a big hit or the K.O.
tag_notes.glass_shards: the K.O. shatter is on screen
tag_notes.glide: the last bar: both balls glide to their corners
tag_notes.hitstop: the 0.35 s hit-stop on the K.O.
tag_notes.marks: fading marks are on the canvas
tag_notes.rev: before FIGHT!: both balls rev in their corners
tag_notes.shimmer: a heat shimmer warps the frame

pattern.sha256_of: the float64 values, little-endian, C order
